# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({                                                              # Suppress startup messages for cleaner logs
  library(sm)                                                                   # For smoothed density plots
  library(dplyr)                                                                # For data manipulation
  library(wateRmelon)                                                           # For DNA methylation analysis functions
  library(SummarizedExperiment)                                                 # For handling SummarizedExperiment objects
  library(parallel)                                                             # For parallel processing backend
  library(doParallel)                                                           # For parallel processing with foreach
})                                                                              # End suppressMessages

base_dir <- "../../.."                                                          # Define project base directory relative to script location
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")                # Define harmonization analysis directory
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "R")                                        # Define directory containing helper R scripts
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/FHS")           # Define directory for processed Framingham data

source(file.path(code_dir, "bmiq_adjust.R"), local = TRUE)                      # source BMIQ adjustment function
source(file.path(code_dir, "bmiq_repeat.R"), local = TRUE)                      # source multi-seed BMIQ wrapper
source(file.path(code_dir, "run_parallel.R"), local = TRUE)                     # source parallel processing helpers 
```

## Load Data

```{r load}
dnam_data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_imputed.RDS"))                   # Read imputed DNA methylation data
dnam_data$age_split_by_tertiles <- ntile(dnam_data$Age, 3)                      # Split age into three tertiles (1, 2, 3)
batches <- dnam_data$Batch                                                      # Extract batch identifiers from metadata
batches <- ifelse(batches == "B0019", "B0018", batches)                         # Merge batch B0019 into B0018 for consistency
dnam_data$Batch <- batches                                                      # Update batch assignments in the object
probe_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                       # Extract probe annotations
  SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%                                           # Get row metadata (probe information)
  as.data.frame()                                                               # Convert to data frame
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                       # Extract sample phenotypes
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                           # Get column metadata (sample information)
  as.data.frame()                                                               # Convert to data frame
beta_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam                       # Extract beta value matrix from assays
```

# Run BMIQ Normalization

## Plot Pre-Normalized Distribution

```{r plot_raw}
probe_type <- ifelse(probe_df$type12 == "I", 1, 2)                              # Convert probe type to numeric (1=Type I, 2=Type II)
sm::sm.density.compare(                                                         # Create density comparison plot
  beta_data[,1],                                                                # Use first sample for visualization
  probe_type                                                                    # Group by probe type
)                                                                               # Plot Type I vs Type II distributions (before)
```

## Run BMIQ

```{r bmiq_run}
beta_data <- multistep_bmiq(                                                    # Perform multi-seed BMIQ normalization
  beta_data,                                                                    # Input beta value matrix
  probe_df,                                                                     # Probe annotations with type information
  seeds = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64),                                            # Try these seeds sequentially for failed samples
  cores = 16                                                                    # Use 16 CPU cores for parallel processing
)                                                                               # Returns normalized beta values
```

## Plot Normalization Effect

```{r plot_normed}
probe_type <- ifelse(probe_df$type12 == "I", 1, 2)                              # Convert probe type to numeric again
sm::sm.density.compare(                                                         # Create density comparison plot
  beta_data[,1],                                                                # Use first sample for visualization
  probe_type                                                                    # Group by probe type
)                                                                               # Plot Type I vs Type II distributions (after)
```

## Create Summarized Experiment object

```{r create_se}
dnam_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(                        # Create new SummarizedExperiment
  assays = list(dnam = beta_data),                                              # Add normalized beta values as assay
  rowData = probe_df,                                                           # Add probe annotations as row metadata
  colData = pheno_df                                                            # Add sample phenotypes as column metadata
)        
```

# Save

## Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_normalized.RDS"))                  # Save final beta-value DNAm object
```
